19 hostile family shapes held: in-bounds verdicts, nameable refusals, no crash, no deep stack (PRD section 6)
oversize but spec-allowed shapes (deep extra nesting, half-megabyte string) answered in-bounds
every emitted refusal code is registered (the G10 vocabulary holds)
minimum-spec shapes held: null url/repo, extra keys, retired aliases, and valid grants all exit 0, zero refusals
the credential wall holds: unknown kind, empty scope, and duplicate grant each refuse by name (G5)
a fresh receipt verifies green; a nested verdict rewrite (E_RECEIPT_TAMPER) and a seq gap (E_RECEIPT_CHAIN) each break the chain by name (G4)
retirement tombstones and keeps a forwarding alias (lint green), a second retire refuses E_RETIRE_ALREADY_TOMBSTONED, and an unknown member refuses E_RETIRE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER (G7)
the emitted pane passes a11y/i18n; no landmark, a click-handler row, no focus ring, and unkeyed chrome each refuse by name (S5/G8)
a bump on a leaf walks to every transitive dependent by name (direct + transitive), and an unknown id refuses E_IMPACT_UNKNOWN_MEMBER (G3)
a dead url refuses E_URL_UNRESOLVABLE by name (exit 1, never a crash) while the offline doctor stays socket-free

the adopter gate holds: a clean family claims suite at >= 2 exactly-pinned adopters; a range pin, a missing govstruct pin, and a declared-but-unchecked adopter each answer by name; a lone adopter is a pilot, never a claim (M2.5)
a clean roll-up carries a versioned path, an ETag, and a max-age and passes; a stale ETag refuses E_ROLLUP_ETAG_STALE and a divergent rendering refuses E_CHECKSUM_DRIFT
a drifted member is named by its exact refusal (floor + lockfile + version + pin style) on one page, a clean member passes, and a member with no checkout is unchecked - never a silent pass
clean family exits 0 with an empty refusals list (the happy wire holds)

the shipped ISO profile is complete (coverage + check green); a profile that resolves nothing (E_ISO_RESOLUTION_MISSING), points at a dangling clause (E_ISO_CLAUSE_UNKNOWN), or claims a clause with no gate each refuses by name - an evidence map, not a certificate (G15)

the shipped surfaces honor the contract (verify + doctor green); a dropped promised field refuses E_SURFACE_FIELD_MISSING and a retyped one refuses E_SURFACE_TYPE_DRIFT, under both `surface --verify` and `doctor` - a consumer can pin a schemaVersion and upgrade consciously (issue #23)
